description: SHA-256 of local source files at training-release extraction; no original files modified.

downstream_evaluation.scope: Small internal-validation examples. Shared reconstruction masks and visible-neighbor mean; coarse-label stratified sampling, unmasked embeddings, L2 normalization, cosine KNN with uniform voting, accuracy and weighted F1.
downstream_evaluation.external_protocol_difference: Full external results additionally use training-reference expression alignment and panel-matched annotation references. The saved external neighbor-mean baseline uses 80% neighbor masking while SOBER uses 20-80%. These internal examples use shared masks and do not implement the full external evaluation.
downstream_evaluation.marker_policy: Literal reconstruction exclusions are applied after alias resolution, matching the saved research analysis; no new canonicalization of exclusion names is introduced.
downstream_evaluation.tutorial_reference: The annotation tutorial uses a class-balanced reference: 64 centers per coarse class from three recorded training regions. This demonstration sampling differs from the manuscript full-atlas reference; query stratification and KNN/metric definitions are unchanged.
